@{5b6b4e8cb1b04a6db0be465d|full_name}: VRChat likes to call itself part of the metaverse, but it felt a heck of a lot more 'metaversey' when the loading screen was in space. Now it feels like I'm in some kind of underwater cyber waiting room. 
I welcome the tips since new players can benefit from them, but the game feels less welcoming without the space background imo.
I'd settle for something else even, I just really dislike the current load screen.

Yeah exactly! 
I talked about this with a friend a while ago.

I'd love to have a toggle for the old space loading screen with the original music. I miss it.
